episodes.title: I Thought I'd Joined A Cult | Kundalini in Widnes
episodes.description:
The first episode of the Chakrology Podcast.
In this episode I talk about:
My first yoga class
Being told I had a snake in my perineum
Walking out of my first workshop
Expensive out-of -touch London yoga culture
And the moment I realised yoga had drifted away from ordinary life.
This podcast explores the brilliant, baffling, meaningful, and sometimes ridiculous world of yoga - bridging mythology, philosophy, nervous system education, and real life.
Yoga was never meant to remove us from the battlefield of life.
It was meant to help us meet it.
Hosted by Jackie Quayle
